summary: Iteration 7 verified the jobs-seed bug fix and the graduate/post-graduate catalog realignment. Backend: 26/26 pytest assertions pass (/api/seo/jobs returns 31 verified jobs incl. ML Engineer, AI Engineer, Cybersecurity Analyst, Data Engineer, Data Scientist, Financial Analyst, PM, UX Designer; /api/seo/careers = 42 with all 10 blue-collar slugs removed and ai-engineer/data-engineer/ml-engineer/cybersecurity-analyst/cloud-engineer present; /api/seo/skills = 48 with AI/deep-learning/nlp/cloud-computing added and trades skills gone; data-scientist & backend-engineer career pages now have non-empty jobs[] + salary_range; no _id leakage; 404s correct). Frontend: /jobs lists 31 cards by default, 'machine'->6, 'cyber'->2, 'new york'->5, 'zzz'->empty-state, 'nurse'->empty-state + registered-nurse career chip (never dead-ends). Job card click -> /jobs/<id> with title, company, requirements and JobPosting JSON-LD. Career detail pages (ai-engineer, data-engineer, ml-engineer, registered-nurse) render H1/answer/core-skill chips/FAQ with only-existing skill links. THREE residual defects found: a sitewide footer link to the deleted /careers/electrician (404 dead-end), stale 'skilled trades / Electrician' marketing copy on /careers and /skills, and the skill/career not-found fallbacks lack data-testid='not-found'.
